reference_spoken: Psalm ninety-one, verses one and two.
verse: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
verse_spoken: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
I will say of the Lord, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
prayer: Heavenly Father, this morning I come into your secret place.
You are my refuge and my fortress, and in you I put my trust.
Cover me under the shadow of your wings as I step into this day.
Guard my mind from fear, my heart from bitterness, and my steps from harm.
Watch over my going out and my coming in, on every road I travel.
Protect my family, my home, and everything you have placed in my care.
Where danger is hidden from my eyes, let your hand go before me.
When I feel exposed or afraid, remind me that I am never outside your reach.
Cover everyone praying with me today, and keep us safe in your love.
